text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1504, 8-1/2" Oiled Bronze Pineapple Door Knocker

The Large Oiled Bronze Palm Springs Pineapple Door Knocker is a wonderful addition to any home. It emulates the ritzy, yet laid-back feel of Palm Springs and its retro look will be sure to add a bit of character to your home. This front door knocker is 8.5 inches tall and 4 inches wide and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware to install it surface mounted on a wood or metal door. The 8-1/2 inch Oiled Bronze Pineapple Door Knocker was designed by Michael Healy, so you can be sure that it is more than just a door knocker, it is jewelry for your door--letting people get a glimpse of your personality before they even knock on the door.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also Available smaller 6-1/2" Oiled Bronze Pineapple Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Pineapple Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 8-1/2
  • Width: 4" at widest part
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 5-3/16"
  • Projection Off Door: 2-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 3 finishes:
Oiled Bronze Brass Nickel Silver

Sold Individually
